description: Land Acquisition - Baddegama South and Ganegama South, Baddegama D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, assessment numbers, descriptions of the land types, claimants, and exact measurements. This falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
